# files_share_group (Data Source)

A ShareGroup is a way for you to store and name groups of email contacts to be used for sending share and inbox invitations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "files_share_group" "example_share_group" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Share Group ID

### Read-Only

- `members` (Dynamic) A list of share group members
- `name` (String) Name of the share group
- `notes` (String) Additional notes of the share group
- `user_id` (Number) Owner User ID

### JSON property details

These properties will move from Dynamic to typed schemas in a major provider release planned for March 1, 2027.

#### members

Contacts in this share group. Creating a share group requires at least one member. An update replaces the members with this list, and an empty list leaves them unchanged. Existing members are matched by email and keep their stored email address.

List of objects.

- `email` (string, required) Email of the share group member
- `name` (string, optional) Name of the share group member
- `company` (string, optional) Company of the share group member
